description: OpenAlex works with a Dagstuhl LIPIcs DOI (10.4230/lipics.*) and more than 1,000 citations. Every one is an upstream merge: a small LIPIcs paper's DOI and usually its title/abstract sit on a record whose citations belong to a famous paper. Records classified citations_from_another_work get cited_by_count_unreliable in overrides/openalex-corrections.json; title_matches_citations records keep their count (it fits the title shown) but carry a wrong DOI and are candidates for a separate card correction.
